title: Digest Item Record
description: The inter-stage contract for the Aviation Technical-Intelligence Digest pipeline. Scanner emits records with confidence=UNVERIFIED and null provenance. Verifier fills provenance and assigns confidence. validate_records.py mechanically enforces the gate before the Writer ever sees a record. See CLAUDE.md and config/fleet.yaml.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug, unique within a run.

headline.description: Triage headline an engineer can read in ~2 seconds.

category.description: fleet = directly involves an operator type; read_across = peer type with read-across; industry = major industry event.

types_affected.description: Aircraft/engine types touched, using fleet.yaml type names.

event_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the event or the governing document. Null only if genuinely undated.

within_window.description: Set by verifier/validator: is event_date inside [current_date - lookback_days, current_date]?

developing_carryover.description: True if this is an older but still-developing event intentionally carried over. Must be flagged in output, never presented as new.

summary.description: What happened, 1-3 sentences, in the analyst's own words.

references.description: Technical artifacts (AD/EAD/SB/SIL/SL/MSG-3). May be empty for a purely event-level item.

oem_regulator_position.description: The OEM/regulator stance (e.g. 'not safety-related', 'no replacement required after failure'). Reported, never the analyst's own determination.

read_across.description: One line: why a peer/industry event matters to the operator fleet. Required in prose when category != fleet.

lead_sources.description: Discovery URLs (incl. trade press). NEVER proof. A lead_source can never satisfy [VERIFIED].

item_confidence.description: Roll-up = the highest confidence present among references; UNVERIFIED if none. Recomputed by the validator.

verifier_notes.description: What the verifier/validator dropped or downgraded and why. Audit trail, not shown to readers.

confidence.description: VERIFIED = confirmed against a publicly-fetched primary source on the allowlist. REPORTED = event reported by trade press, no primary technical reference confirmed. UNVERIFIED = reference exists but text not accessed (e.g. gated).

ref_date.description: ISO date of the reference document.

primary_source_url.description: URL of the publicly-fetched primary document. REQUIRED and must be on verified_domains for confidence=VERIFIED.

primary_source_domain.description: Host of primary_source_url, www-stripped. Recomputed/validated by the gate.

fetched_text_snippet.description: A short excerpt the verifier actually read from the primary doc. REQUIRED (non-trivial length) for confidence=VERIFIED. This is the proof of fetch.

audit.description: Added by the independent Auditor stage. A VERIFIED reference is downgraded by validate_records.py --require-audit unless audit.status == 'confirmed' with a real excerpt.

checked_url.description: The URL the auditor actually fetched.

excerpt.description: Real text the auditor read from the page (>=20 chars to keep VERIFIED).

text.description: Verbatim excerpt, <= quotes.max_words (default 25) from config. Only from fetched text.

url.description: Source document URL. Must be on verified_domains, else the quote is dropped by the gate.
